case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

Thank you for your quotation and for the warm words. We value your interest in a long-term partnership and would like to build planning security together.

Our data shows a different picture on delivery reliability and on cost development:

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

Based on this, we have prepared options that we see as a serious basis for a stable, lasting cooperation. Each of them gives you a clear framework for planning.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.08; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.75; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

We would be glad to hear which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms. Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quote and for the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies. We value that partnership and want a fair solution for both sides.

To be open with you, the price is not yet where we need it. Our data shows this picture:

Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

We would still like to work with you, so we have prepared three genuine options. They differ in payment terms, so you can choose the one that suits you best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 28.19; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 27.37; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 28.00; payment 30 days net; lead time 35 days.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I kept the lead time at 52 days because 35 days would just make things more expensive for you, and we want to keep the price down. 

To show we are serious about working together long-term, I can drop the price to €31.00. Our main offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. As an alternative at our standard terms, a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
